name: Structured Chunked Data Transfer Over DNS
detects: Structured chunked data transfer over DNS based on unique chunk indexes after exact-event deduplication.
does_not_detect: Completed exfiltration by itself; completion and receiver reconstruction are forensic confidence/outcome evidence.
logic: Exact-dedup first. Parse transfer grammar. Group same source+destination/domain+transfer_object; match >=5 unique chunk indexes in 5m. Completion marker is enrichment only.
dedup: Prefer native event ID; fallback fingerprint: timestamp + src/dst tuple + DNS ID + QR + query + frame length.
tuning: Do not require query length >=150 or a completion marker. Exclude known governed DNS data channels only with stable ownership/context.
risk: Low-and-slow chunking can evade threshold; weak dedup keys can inflate counts; DNS retransmissions need exact-event handling.
response: Inspect process-to-network lineage, unique chunk sequence, domain/destination, volume, completion marker, receiver object and hash evidence.
test_status: Tested with local canonical evaluator and public fixture suite; source-derived validation references reviewed
platform_status: No native SIEM execution; platform files are syntax/semantic candidates only
